parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.text:
Calcium nitrate, $\text{Ca(NO}_3\text{)}_2$, decomposes on heating.

Write an equation for the decomposition of calcium nitrate.

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text:
Describe the trend in the decomposition temperature of the Group 2 nitrates.

Explain your answer.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
A sample of $0.333\text{ g}$ of strontium oxide, $\text{SrO}$, is completely dissolved in distilled water to form a solution of strontium hydroxide, $\text{Sr(OH)}_2$.

The resulting solution is added to a volumetric flask and made up to $250.0\text{ cm}^3$ with distilled water.

Calculate the pH of this solution at $298\text{ K}$. Give your answer to **two** decimal places.
